title: Order/payment reconciliation
prompt: Return order_id,status,item_cents,payment_cents,result for ALL orders; 0 for missing totals, result MATCH for paid and equal, MISMATCH for other paid, NOT_PAID otherwise; sort order_id.
hint: Aggregate payments and order lines separately.

title: Two latest paid orders per customer
prompt: Return customer_id,order_id,ordered_at for at most two paid orders per customer; sort customer_id,date DESC,id DESC.

title: Recursive org depth
prompt: Return employee_id,full_name,depth for all employees; leaders depth=0, reports increment; sort employee_id.
hint: Seed managers IS NULL, then recurse.

title: Direct-report counts
prompt: Return manager_id,manager_name,direct_reports for ALL employees incl zero reports; sort reports DESC,id ASC.
hint: Self LEFT JOIN then COUNT(child ID).

title: Keyset pagination
prompt: Return order_id,ordered_at for 5 orders strictly after cursor ('2026-04-06',105), ascending ordered_at,order_id.
hint: Compare date and ID as composite cursor.

title: Order outstanding amounts
prompt: Return order_id,status,item_cents,paid_cents,due_cents for every order, due=max(item_cents-paid_cents,0); sort order_id.
hint: Compute each fact separately before joining.

title: Signup-to-purchase cohort
prompt: Return customer_id,signup_month,first_paid_month for all customers (NULL first_paid_month if none); sorted by customer_id.
hint: Aggregate first paid date then left join.

title: Customer payment totals
prompt: Return customer_id,full_name,total_payment_cents for ALL customers including zero, sorted total DESC then customer_id.

title: Team headcount
prompt: Return team_name,headcount,avg_salary_cents for ALL teams including empty ones, NULL average if no staff; sort team_name.

title: Category revenue share
prompt: Return category_name,revenue_cents,share_pct (percent of total paid-line revenue, rounded to 2 decimals) for ALL categories. Sort revenue DESC then category_name.
hint: Revenue CTE then SUM OVER all categories.

title: Unsold active SKUs
prompt: Return sku,product_name for ACTIVE products never appearing in a paid order line; sort sku.
hint: Use NOT EXISTS with paid status.

title: Paid order mismatches
prompt: Return order_id,discrepancy_cents (item total minus payment total) for PAID orders where totals differ, missing payment counts 0; sort id. Normal dataset has none, edge dataset has a discrepancy.
hint: The edge fixture changes an existing payment.

title: Audit counts by month
prompt: Return month (YYYY-MM),event_type,event_count from audit_events, sorted month,event_type.

title: Customers with no paid orders
prompt: Return customer_id,full_name for customers without a paid order, even if pending/cancelled orders exist; sort id.

title: Last paid date and lifetime spend
prompt: Return customer_id,full_name,last_paid_at,paid_cents for EVERY customer; NULL date and 0 spend if none; sort id.
hint: Use one row per order before aggregation.

title: Top SKU per category
prompt: Return category_name,sku,paid_units for ONE top paid-selling product per category with sales; tie-break sku ascending; sort category_name.
